Common.name: Apprentice Magician
Common.desc: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place 1 Spell Counter on that target. If this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Spellcaster monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

Common.name: Blast Magician
Common.desc: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. You can remove any number of Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field with ATK less than or equal to the number of counters you removed x 700; destroy that target.

Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
● Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Common.desc: Field Spell Cards on the field cannot be destroyed. Neither player can activate a new Field Spell Card. You can only control 1 "Field Barrier".

If this card would be destroyed, you can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card instead.

Common.name: Old Vindictive Magician

Common.name: Terraforming

Common.name: Twister

Ultra Rare.name: Endymion, the Master Magician
Ultra Rare.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or GY) by removing 6 Spell Counters from a "Magical Citadel of Endymion" you control.
